column1: # The kit is a property of the GEO/SRA study (every run in a study uses one prep),
# so it is assigned here from the published methods, NOT auto-detected from reads.
# Known kit names (see pipelines/lib/kit_params.sh for the param mapping):
#   illumina      TruSeq / standard Illumina small RNA  -> -a illumina, no UMI
#   nextflex_v3   NEXTflex Small RNA-Seq v3             -> -a illumina + -umi 4,4 (4+4 random-mers)
#   nebnext       NEBNext small RNA                     -> -a AGATCGGAAGAGCACACGTCTGAACTCCAGTCAC, no UMI
# Any dataset not listed here defaults to "illumina".
